BillHeading.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the flying of certain flags from Washington state ferry system vessels and terminals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to flying flags from Washington state ferry system vessels and terminals; and adding a new section to chapter 47.60 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 47.60 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) The Washington state ferry system may not fly a flag on any vessel or terminal that it operates, other than the flag of the United States, the flag of Washington state, or a maritime flag.
(2) For the purposes of this section, "maritime flag" means a flag that is flown as part of the international code of signals for the purpose of communication between vessels.
